subject: HelioChain reference deployment — acceptance criteria & test plan
messages:
From: Anika Mehta <anika@heliochain.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir@heliochain.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T16:14:00-07:00
Subject: HelioChain reference deployment — initial architecture and test ask

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call earlier — Samir and I have attached the first pass of our reference deployment diagram (heliochain-reference-arch-v1.pdf) and a short list of acceptance goals we want Redwood to validate before we list the integration in our marketplace. Broadly: authentication flows, end-to-end inference latency under a 2ms token-profile, and secure audit log propagation to our SIEM.

Can your team run a targeted validation and produce:
- A short acceptance checklist (CSV with pass/fail rows)
- A minimal smoke test harness we can run in our staging account
- Notes on any platform gaps or required config changes

We are targeting marketplace listing in Q4 and would like a signoff by 2026-09-20. Doable?

Attachments: heliochain-reference-arch-v1.pdf (diagram, 1pg)

Regards,
Anika Mehta
Head of Partnerships, HelioChain
Anika.Mehta@heliochain.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anika Mehta <anika@heliochain.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelioChain reference deployment — initial architecture and test ask

Hi Anika — thanks for the diagram and the clarity on goals. We're happy to validate. I looped in Karthik (solution engineering) and Laura (integrations lead) to scope the work. Next steps we propose: 

1) Redwood delivers an acceptance checklist (CSV) and a short test harness repo with instructions by 2026-09-16.
2) Karthik will run the E2E latency and auth flow tests in HelioChain staging; Laura will validate audit-log delivery and retention settings.
3) We will produce a short findings doc and an action list for any gaps.

Action owners: Karthik (latency/auth tests), Laura (audit/logging), Marissa (signoff and partner comms).

I've attached a template acceptance checklist to speed the process (heliochain-acceptance-checklist.csv). If HelioChain wants to modify criteria, tell us by EOD 9/14.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachments: heliochain-acceptance-checklist.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Anika Mehta <anika@heliochain.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelioChain reference deployment — initial architecture and test ask

Marissa / Anika,

Quick technical notes after a first pass on the PDF and our staging runbook:
- Auth: HelioChain's proposal uses an external OIDC provider for user tokens and a service account flow for server-to-server. Redwood supports both; we will validate token exchange and JWT claims mapping.
- Latency: To reach the 2ms per-token target we need to confirm average sequence length and batching profile. If HelioChain expects short single-shot queries, we'll run a low-latency configuration (dedicated pool, zero batching). For conversational/longer context we will profile a 32-token and 512-token distribution.
- Audit logs: We can forward logs to their SIEM via secure syslog or S3 delivery with KMS; need sample ingest credentials.

Requests for HelioChain:
1) Provide a small sample workload (500 requests) with token-length distribution OR confirm expected profile.
2) Provide a staging account SSH key and SIEM ingest endpoint details (or a temp S3 bucket).

I'll start drafting the smoke-test harness (simple Python runner + k6 load script) and will attach the repo link by EOD 9/15.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Anika Mehta <anika@heliochain.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir@heliochain.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelioChain reference deployment — initial architecture and test ask

Thanks Karthik — quick answers inline: 

> 1) Provide a small sample workload (500 requests) with token-length distribution OR confirm expected profile.
Samir attached a CSV with a representative set (short/med/long buckets). We'll also push a sample job to the staging S3 bucket.

> 2) Provide a staging account SSH key and SIEM ingest endpoint details (or a temp S3 bucket).
We'll provision a temp S3 bucket and share credentials via your secure portal. SIEM endpoint is a Splunk HTTP Event Collector (we'll send token + index later).

We prefer Redwood to run the latency profile with two configurations: 1) Dedicated low-latency pool (no batching) and 2) Cost-balanced pool (batching enabled) — include throughput and 95th percentile numbers for both.

We also noted one minor ask: can Redwood preserve per-request metadata headers (x-hc-request-id, x-hc-client) through the whole pipeline so our audit logs have the partner correlation id? Let us know if there are any blockers.

Attachments: heliochain-workload-sample.csv (Samir)

Best,
Anika

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anika Mehta <anika@heliochain.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T15:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelioChain reference deployment — initial architecture and test ask

All — thanks for the quick turn. Summary and next steps before the gated signoff meeting on Monday 2026-09-20 10:00 PT (invite to follow):

Checklist deliverables (what Redwood will send by 9/16 EOD):
- Completed acceptance CSV (attached) with owner notes (Karthik/Laura)
- Smoke-test harness (private repo link): includes Python runner and k6 scripts, plus commands to reproduce latency profiles.
- Findings doc: short list of platform tweaks (one minor change required — preserve x-hc-request-id in headers; engineering estimate: config toggle, low risk).
- Test artifacts: raw k6 output and aggregated P95/P99 numbers for both pool configs.

Owners and quick ask: Karthik — please attach the repo link + P95/P99 CSV. Laura — validate SIEM ingestion and retention policy mapping and confirm KMS usage. Anika/Samir — confirm the staging S3 creds by EOD so we can run the harness overnight.

Attachments: heliochain-test-scripts.zip (contains README + reproducible tests)

If all green, we'll prepare a short marketplace listing blurb and a partner playbook with onboarding steps. If HelioChain needs any modified acceptance criteria, raise before the meeting so we can update the checklist.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
